_comment: The LEC video library's pixel format (gra.c of lecsmush/insane, 2026-11-14), which gra_ConvertToLecColor / gra_ConvertFromLecColor / gra_ConvertCopy convert between: bytes per pixel, colour model, and per channel the bits, the shift and the loss (the shift that scales an 8-bit channel down), with an alpha channel. The 555 / 565 shortcuts test it (shifts 10/5/0, 0/5/11, 11/5/0 with 2 bytes per pixel).

structs.name: LecPixelFormat
structs.comment: A pixel format of the LEC video library (Insane / Smush).
fields: RGB: bits of red (index into g_aConvert_bitmask); indexed: the palette pointer
